name: interactive-mindmap-editor
description: Create, repair, and export interactive HTML and XMind mind maps.

interface.shortDescription: Create HTML and XMind mind maps.
interface.longDescription: Helps Codex convert text, outlines, articles, and notes into editable standalone HTML mind maps or XMind-compatible .xmind files, and repair interaction issues such as two-line editing, collapse hit areas, overlap, wrapping, and recursive node operations.
interface.defaultPrompt: Turn my text into an editable HTML mind map or XMind file, or help me improve an existing interactive mind map editor.
